Best for sweets and some Snacks!

I always purchase sweets and snacks from here , I have previously given  5 ratings but today I was very disappointed when I consumed the ' Aamras' (Mango Juice) .

They said it's made up of Alphonse Mango , but after consuming my family members realised it's full of artificial flavours. Not only that all my family members including myself had throth  pain immidietly after consuming Aamras'.... We did not expect this from Chetan as we always purchase sweets , snacks, shrikhand here.

I would still  recommend buying sweets, snacks, shrikhand ... But I request chetan to double check the quality when introducing new items in their list .
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for being a regular customer and for sharing your feedback honestly.

We sincerely regret your experience with the Aamras. What you described is concerning and certainly not the experience we want any customer or family to have. We take product quality very seriously, and your feedback regarding the taste, artificial flavour concern, and throat discomfort will be immediately reviewed with our team.

We truly value your continued trust in our sweets, snacks, and shrikhand, and we appreciate that you took the time to point this out instead of staying silent. Feedback like this helps us improve and be more careful when introducing new products.

Thank you again for your support and for highlighting this issue.

Dear Customer,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We truly value every opinion as it helps us improve.

We would like to clarify that our Loyalty Points Program is completely transparent — the points earned are clearly mentioned on every bill, and the same bill is also shared on your WhatsApp number immediately after billing. Additionally, we have flyers and flash on digital screen displayed in-store explaining our BYOB (Bring Your Own Bag) campaign, where customers earn 5 loyalty points for carrying their own bag.

The points earned can be redeemed on your next visit once they reach the eligible threshold which is 50 Loyalty Points, as per our policy. We’re sorry if this wasn’t clearly communicated during your visit, and we’ll ensure our team reiterates this to all customers going forward.

We never intend to hide any information or inconvenience our customers — our goal is always to encourage eco-friendly habits and reward loyalty.

We truly appreciate your feedback and hope to serve you better next time.

Regards,
Chetan Dryfruit

featured_reviews.review_text:
Nestled in the heart of Nallasopara, Dairy and Sweet is a haven for anyone with a penchant for indulgence. From the moment you step through the door, the aroma of freshly baked goods and the sight of colorful confections captivate your senses.

The selection here is simply outstanding. Whether you're craving creamy ice cream, decadent cakes, or artisanal chocolates, Dairy and Sweet has it all. Their dairy products are sourced locally, ensuring freshness and quality that you can taste with every bite.

One of the highlights of my visit was their assortment of flavored ice creams. From classic vanilla to exotic mango and everything in between, there's a flavor to suit every palate. And if you're feeling adventurous, don't miss their seasonal specials – they're always a delightful surprise.

But it's not just about the sweets; the ambiance of Dairy and Sweet adds to the overall experience.

What truly sets Dairy and Sweet apart, however, is their exceptional customer service. The staff members are friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about their craft. They're always ready to offer recommendations or help you create the perfect custom dessert for any occasion.

In summary, Dairy and Sweet is a gem of a spot for anyone with a sweet tooth. Whether you're treating yourself to a solo indulgence or celebrating a special occasion with loved ones, this charming establishment never disappoints. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a memorable culinary experience!

featured_reviews.name: Mustafa Dhukka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wastern Cakes & Bakes is an absolute treat for anyone with a sweet tooth! The moment you enter, the fresh aroma of baked goods instantly makes you feel happy and hungry. The shop is neat, well-organized, and beautifully decorated with tempting displays of cakes, pastries, and breads.

Their cake variety is impressive — from classic flavors like Black Forest and Red Velvet to custom-designed theme cakes, every option looks and tastes amazing. I tried their chocolate truffle cake, and it was rich, moist, and perfectly balanced in sweetness. The cream was light and smooth, not overly heavy like many bakeries.

The pastries are equally delightful — fresh, soft, and bursting with flavor. Their cookies and brownies are also a must-try, especially with a hot cup of coffee. I was happy to see that they use good-quality ingredients, which really reflects in the taste.

The staff is polite, patient, and helpful, guiding you through their menu and even suggesting combinations for special occasions. They also offer quick customization for birthday or anniversary cakes, and the designs are always creative and beautifully done.

Prices are very reasonable considering the quality and freshness of the products. They also have good packaging, ensuring that the cakes and pastries remain perfect even if you’re taking them for a party.

Overall, Wastern Cakes & Bakes is not just a bakery — it’s a place where quality, taste, and presentation come together perfectly. Highly recommended for every celebration or just to satisfy your dessert cravings.
